name: stackwell
description: A calm right-side status pane for Claude Code: context, quota, steward, hatch, folders, agents and session at a glance, grey by default with colour only for groups and for warn and crit. It observes only and never hooks tool calls.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: auto (palette file if set, else Claude Code's light or dark theme), vga, mocha, tokyo-night or latte.

quotaDir.title: Quota folder
quotaDir.description: Folder of per-account quota JSON files shown as account rows; a missing folder shows none.

paletteFile.title: Palette file
paletteFile.description: A file holding a '# >>> PALETTE' ... '# <<< PALETTE' block of NAME=R,G,B lines; used when the theme is auto. Empty: off.

sessionDirs.title: Session folders
sessionDirs.description: Folders of Claude Code session files for steward peer status; for example ~/.claude/sessions; a '*' in a part of the path matches any folder name there. Empty: this session's own config folder.

showIcon.title: Show icon
showIcon.description: Draw the mod's icon in the header and the section icons on terminals that show images; off, the section words everywhere.
